name: New Startups

sources.title: New Startups homepage — 'launchpad for new startups' (browser-check walled)
Third-party profile: paid $50 submission, no longer free
Third-party note: site behind browser-verification wall

requirements: Free submissions are no longer accepted per third-party trackers ('costs $50')
Reported packages: Express Submission $50 (review + publish, minimum 30-day homepage presence) and Express + Social Media Promotion $100 (Twitter/Facebook promotion to 18K+ followers)
Startup gallery/peer-review model — submission is a written profile reviewed within a stated ~48 hours
preparation: Startup details and thoughtful answers to the submission questionnaire (narrative quality affects the published post)
workflow: Open https://www.new-startups.com/ (expect a browser-verification interstitial — automation blocked)
Navigate to the submission page (historically /promote-your-startup-company/ or a 'submit' path)
Choose Express ($50) or Express + Social ($100) and pay on the redirect to the payment page
Site reviews and publishes within ~48 hours per third-party guides
watchFor: Site sits behind a browser-verification wall — headless submissions will fail; use a real browser session
No free tier currently — any 'free submission' guides are stale
Homepage presence is time-boxed (~30 days), then the post persists as a gallery entry
Verify the actual submit URL in-session; older documented paths may have changed
countsAsLive: A published startup profile/review post on new-startups.com (and homepage placement during the paid window)
unknowns: Exact current submission URL and form fields
Whether prices remain $50/$100 (figures are from third-party sources)
